episode_summary: In this episode, Frances Katzen shares her insights on navigating the New York real estate market amidst new taxes and policies. She emphasizes the importance of having a strong opinion and leveraging media appearances to build a personal brand. Frances also discusses her approach to creating engaging market reports and empowering her team with diverse opinions.
